segments.name: Africa
segments.description: Managed gold mining operations in Egypt, Ghana, Guinea and Tanzania plus a non-managed joint venture in the DRC.
segments.evidence: Africa — managed operations in Egypt, Ghana, Guinea and Tanzania and a non-managed joint venture operation in the DRC;

segments.name: Australia
segments.description: Managed gold mining operations in Australia.

segments.name: Americas
segments.description: Managed operations in Argentina and Brazil, with exploration and development projects in the United States and Colombia.
segments.evidence: Americas — managed operations in Argentina and Brazil, exploration and development projects in the United States and exploration projects in Colombia.

segments.name: Projects
segments.description: Comprises all the major non-sustaining capital projects with the potential to be developed into operating entities.
segments.evidence: AngloGold Ashanti's operating segments are divided into geographical regions, in addition to a Projects segment, which comprises all the major non-sustaining capital projects with the potential to be developed into operating entities.

revenueModel.text: The company sells refined gold directly to bullion banks, and by-products such as silver and sulphuric acid, on world markets.
revenueModel.evidence: This refined gold is then sold directly to bullion banks.

changes.text: In 2024, AngloGold Ashanti acquired Centamin plc, adding the Sukari mine in Egypt to the Africa segment.
changes.evidence: In November 2024, AngloGold Ashanti completed its acquisition of Centamin plc ("Centamin"), a Jersey gold mining and exploration company whose primary asset is the Sukari gold mine in Egypt, for a consideration of approximately $2.2 billion comprising a combination of AGA shares and cash .

changes.text: In 2025, the company sold the Serra Grande mine in Brazil, removing it from the Americas segment.
changes.evidence: On 1 December 2025, AngloGold Ashanti completed the sale of Mineração Serra Grande S.A., which owns the Serra Grande mine ("MSG") in the state of Goiás, Brazil, to Aura Minerals Inc.

changes.text: In 2025, the company sold the Doropo and ABC projects in Côte d'Ivoire to Resolute Mining Limited.
changes.evidence: On 1 May 2025, AngloGold Ashanti completed the sale of the Doropo project and the Archean-Birimian Contact ("ABC") project in Côte d'Ivoire to Resolute Mining Limited ("Resolute").
